note: Operational tributary strategy. Freshness, source identity, flow-path and hydraulic checks must pass before continuity use. Stage is diagnostic only and is never converted to discharge.

ohio.notes: Olmsted is the representative Ohio inflow when fresh and unit-verified; lower Ohio/Cairo stage remains a backwater check.

arkansas.primary: USACE Wilbur D. Mills Dam total release
arkansas.notes: Use parsed turbine+spillway total release at the downstream-most control structure. Lower-channel travel/storage caveat remains explicit.

illinois.notes: Valley City is accepted as representative for screening-level Mississippi inflow; modest intervening drainage and timing caveats remain.

white.primary: USACE Clarendon flow (NPTA4), with USGS DeValls Bluff context
white.notes: Clarendon measured flow is the quantitative anchor. Norrell and St. Charles stage trends and NWM checkpoint flow are reconciliation/backwater diagnostics; stage is never converted to Q.

stfrancis.primary: Mississippi mainstem residual between Helena HEEA4 and Tunica Mhoon Landing MHOM6
stfrancis.notes: Prefer observed bounding flow when NOAA payload units prove it is discharge; otherwise use same-model NWM analysis at both checkpoints. Report as St. Francis-area net lateral residual, not an isolated measured tributary hydrograph.

meramec.notes: Eureka observed discharge remains primary. Arnold and Herculaneum stage trends screen for lower-river/backwater changes. Same-model NWM St. Louis-to-Herculaneum residual provides a quantitative cross-check and fallback when Eureka is unavailable.

small_tributary_policy.notes: Tributaries below the priority set may be grouped within bounding Mississippi reaches. A group residual represents unresolved net lateral contribution and must not be assigned to individual small tributaries without independent evidence.
